title: Create src/lib/backends/docker.ts — Docker sandbox backend
description: Implement the AgentBackend interface for Claude running in a Docker sandbox. Spawns the docker sandbox run command. Validates that docker is in PATH.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/backends/docker.ts exists and exports a DockerBackend implementing AgentBackend
spawn() runs 'docker sandbox run claude . -- --model opus -p <prompt>'
Missing docker binary throws a descriptive error

steps.details: Create the file. Import spawn from child_process, execSync. Import types from types.ts.
Check for 'docker' in PATH: `try { execSync('which docker', { stdio: 'ignore' }) } catch { throw new Error('docker not found in PATH. Install Docker from https://docker.com') }`

spawn(prompt: string, options: BackendOptions): ChildProcess { // check binary; return spawn('docker', ['sandbox', 'run', 'claude', '.', '--', '--model', 'opus', '-p', prompt], { cwd: options.cwd || process.cwd(), stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }) }
Same parseOutput as claude backend. Export: export const dockerBackend: AgentBackend = { name: 'Claude (Docker sandbox)', spawn, parseOutput }

technicalNotes: The 'docker sandbox' subcommand is part of Claude Code's Docker integration — not standard Docker
The '.' argument tells Docker to mount the current directory as the workspace
